component.name: Jots
component.summary: Lightweight sticky notes for Linux with Markdown and AI-ready sync

description.p: Jots is a fast, lightweight sticky-notes app: Markdown editing with live formatting and checklists, plain .md file storage you can back up anywhere, and 12 pastel themes that hold up in light and dark mode.
Notes can sync to any Git remote on a schedule or on demand, a privacy mode hides sensitive text on screen, and an MCP server lets compatible AI assistants create, search and manage notes directly.
